docs commit: NEX-081 checkpoint (this file) - see git log, it cannot name itself
decisions_this_run: D-081a: a cursor on the existing report rather than an uncapped sweep. An uncapped scan holds the database open for every agent's whole trail; the cap was a legitimate bound, the missing cursor was the defect.
D-081b: `verified` also requires offset == 0. A clean second page examined some agents, not the deployment; folding the two would let an operator page through a broken deployment and see only passes.
D-081c: order the sweep listing by (created_at, id), not created_at alone. Paging depends on the order being total, or an OFFSET page can skip an agent and still look full.
D-081d: validate offset in the use case (InvalidInput) as well as the query layer, and AFTER the operator gate, so a non-operator gets 404 and cannot probe the validation.
run_summary: Run 81 delivered NEX-081: a capped audit-integrity sweep can now be finished. The sweep was operator-gated and complete for small deployments, but it walked only the oldest `max_agents` agents and offered no way to ask for the rest. `truncated` was honest about the exclusion yet left the operator with nothing to do about it, and the excluded agents were the newest chains - exactly the ones written most recently, and so the likeliest to be tampered with. GET /api/v1/ops/audit-integrity now takes `offset` and reports `next_offset`; the listing is ordered by (created_at, id) so a page boundary is total; and `verified` additionally requires offset == 0, so a clean page after the first can never read as a deployment-wide all-clear. 16 targeted tests, full suite green, ruff+mypy clean. The `offset == 0` guard was proved load-bearing by removing it and watching the intended test fail. CI was not polled - NEX-081 is COMMITTED + PUSHED, not VERIFIED.

run_report: NEX-079: give an operator grant a way to end early. Before this a grant ended only by expiry, so a mistaken hand-out was stuck for its term and a configuration grant (granted_by IS NULL) could not be ended at all without editing the seed and redeploying. Revocation is recorded on the row, not applied by DELETE, because the point of keeping a grant is that an audit can read what authority existed; a delete erases the grant and the evidence it was removed. 12 files, +720/-10. 11 new API tests. Full suite green locally. Two pre-existing-test/migration defects found and fixed before commit (duplicate index; stale column-set assertion).
